title: Bijectivity of the middle localization comparison
statement: Under the Mayer–Vietoris localization diagram and local comparison hypotheses, the middle comparison additive homomorphism is bijective in every degree.

proof.text: On each W intersected with S, multiplication by s^n is an isomorphism because s trivializes L. The fraction formula hc therefore determines c on every fraction. Fractions generate the quotient of the direct sum, so the formula determines the additive homomorphism uniquely. Apply the localized Mayer–Vietoris diagram theorem, identify its nonvanishing open with S by equality of underlying sets, and identify its comparison family with c by uniqueness. This transfers all exactness and commuting squares to c. The former arbitrary-c signature was false: on Spec k for a nonzero field with U = V = S = top, L = F = O, s = 1 and c W p = 0, its premises held but its degree-zero conclusion failed. The added hc excludes that historical counterexample.

Use the same uniqueness on fractions to identify c on U, V and U intersect V with the equivalences in h_locU, h_locV and the restored h_locUV fraction formula. The local and product comparison maps are bijective in all degrees.

In degree zero both union-to-product maps are injective. A kernel element of the union comparison maps to zero in the upper product by injectivity of the product comparison, hence is zero. To lift a lower union element, lift its image in the product through the product comparison. Commutativity and injectivity of the intersection comparison put the lift in the upper kernel; upper exactness lifts it to the union, and lower injectivity identifies its image with the original element.

For p = q + 1 take the five consecutive terms: product in degree q, intersection in degree q, union in degree q + 1, product in degree q + 1, intersection in degree q + 1. The exact rows and commuting squares, with all four outside comparisons bijective, give the middle bijection by the additive five lemma. Together with degree zero this proves the conclusion for every p. This is the full intended proof of the corrected interface; its Lean proof remains sorry.

theorem localized_middle_comparison_bijective
    (X : Scheme.{u_1}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (S : X.Opens) (hS : (S : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus L s)
    (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (c : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (p : ℕ), CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p W →+
      (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (W ⊓ S)).obj F)
    (hc : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (p n : ℕ)
        (ξ : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p W).obj
          (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
      (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (W ⊓ S)).map
          (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
            F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules))
          (c W p (cohomologyFraction L F s p W n ξ)) =
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ S ≤ W))).app
            (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ)
    (h_locU : ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ e : CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p U ≃+
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (U ⊓ S)).obj F,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p U).obj
          (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (U ⊓ S)).map
            (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
              F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules))
            (e (cohomologyFraction L F s p U n ξ)) =
          (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ S ≤ U))).app
              (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ)
    (h_locV : ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ e : CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p V ≃+
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (V ⊓ S)).obj F,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p V).obj
          (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (V ⊓ S)).map
            (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
              F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules))
            (e (cohomologyFraction L F s p V n ξ)) =
          (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ S ≤ V))).app
              (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ)
    (h_locUV : ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ e : CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p (U ⊓ V) ≃+
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (U ⊓ V ⊓ S)).obj F,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (U ⊓ V)).obj
          (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (U ⊓ V ⊓ S)).map
            (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
              F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules))
            (e (cohomologyFraction L F s p (U ⊓ V) n ξ)) =
          (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⊓ S ≤ U ⊓ V))).app
              (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ) :
    ∀ p : ℕ, Function.Bijective (c (U ⊔ V) p)
